title: Upgrade free listeners
statementMd:
Move every free listener who signed up before 2022 to the `premium` plan, then count listeners per plan.

Expected columns: `plan`, `listeners`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
UPDATE listeners SET plan = 'premium' WHERE plan = 'free' AND signup_date < '2022-01-01'; SELECT plan, COUNT(*) AS listeners FROM listeners GROUP BY plan;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
